verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a hosted payments-facilitation service. Self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product, since some payment platforms ship self-hostable deployments, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the core product can be self-hosted. The on-premises guide only covers receiving Rainforest webhooks inside a platform's private network, and data export is a separate capability; neither counts as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
